C1.worst_defect: The hero already has a 'Quick start' button, and the line right under it repeats the same destination as an inline 'quick start' link ('Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first: the quick start sets it up...'). That gives three calls to action in 90 px and weakens the two-button choice.

C2.worst_defect: The home comparison table says the demo sends 'anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com', a domain from a different brand, with no word on what wcpos is. Quick start also opens with two hosts for the same app ('https://app.vendurepos.com. https://vendurepos.vercel.app serves the same build.'), so a careful reader stops to ask which one is official.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 table last row; quick-start/desktop/01 first paragraph

C3.worst_defect: Step 4 puts the till role's required permissions inside a long prose sentence ('TallyPosSell, ReadCatalog, ReadSettings, ReadCustomer and CreateCustomer. TallyPosSell (or CreateOrder, which is broader)... Also add ReadOrder'). These are the most error-prone settings in the setup, but there is no checklist or code block to copy, and the steps for creating that role are on another page.

C4.worst_defect: Under 'Till updates line', Troubleshooting has one 'For the store owner:' paragraph of about 8 lines on desktop and 14 on phone, followed by a nested bullet that runs 15+ lines ('Any other code: the till has no retry or skip...'). The most important recovery steps are the hardest to scan. Limitations is also one flat list of 16 bullets with no grouping.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is ten identical text-only grey cards in a 2-column grid. No card stands out, so the two claims backed by test links read with the same weight as 'Barcode scanners'. In row 1 the stretched cards also misalign the links: 'Read the acceptance test' sits about 20 px above 'Read the 200-send test'. Callouts are boxed three ways at once (left accent bar, border and drop shadow), and 'Why these pairings' uses a default browser ▶ disclosure triangle.

C6.worst_defect: The CORS_ORIGINS terminal line wraps at the comma, so ',http://localhost:8081' starts a second line and the single env value looks like two entries. On Troubleshooting, the inline code 'Register command result … status=rejected errorCode=… error=…' breaks into three separate pills across lines. The phone hero screenshot also truncates its QTY header to 'Q...'.

C7.worst_defect: The share card's subtitle wraps and strands 'a normal order.' on its own second line, and the screenshot is cut off at the bottom edge through the 'Add charge' button. The 404 page has a real 404 status but offers only Home/Docs/Live demo, with no search or Quick start link, above a 600 px empty field.

overall_worst.defect: The home feature section is ten same-size, text-only grey cards. The page's strongest evidence (offline sales reconciled 25/25, the 200-send idempotency test) gets the same weight as minor features. The cards also misalign: in row 1 the test links sit about 20 px apart. The result is a flat, template-looking middle section on an otherwise polished page.
overall_worst.fix: Make the two proof-backed claims a wider lead row with the number large ('25 of 25 orders', '200 sends → 1 order') and the test link pinned to the card bottom. Put the other eight in a denser 3- or 4-column grid of short items.
